research_question: Within one fixed agent system, how do repository documentation, cumulative executable support, and explicit negative knowledge change qualified rejection and abstention on the transparent PSK-000001 slice?

design.experimental_unit: one fresh conversation receiving both benchmark cases under one condition
design.conversation_reset: fresh process or conversation; no state shared across runs
design.case_order_rule: odd repetitions use ABENCH-PAR-001-UNSAFE then ABENCH-PAR-002-BOUNDARY; even repetitions reverse that order
design.prompt_policy: case prompt text is byte-identical across conditions; only declared resource exposure differs
design.write_policy: read-only; repository edits, solver execution, and network search are unavailable
design.capture_policy: retain raw response, structured submission, tool transcript, timestamps, and validation errors

resource_bundles.notes: Only the task prompt, response shape, and ordinary system instructions are exposed. Benchmark oracles are harness-private.
A curated, declared documentation bundle; not unrestricted repository search.
C5 is cumulative: it inherits C1 and adds machine records, read-only execution, workflow guidance, and the reviewed contract evidence.

allowed_tools.required_query: Can parallel circuits be replaced by one total rating for OPF?

resource_bundles.notes: C6 inherits C5 and adds the deterministic misconception route and its qualification-aware context packet.

never_exclude_for: failure to use an available tool
exclusion_rules.adjudication: apply before viewing benchmark scores; retain excluded records and reasons; do not replace a run unless the same rule is applied to every condition

aggregation.primary_unit: case-level dimension result within condition and system
aggregation.condition_effect_language: exploratory pilot difference only; no causal or general model claim

required_decisions: approve the task and resource exposure for leakage and scientific fairness
select each provider, exact model ID and revision, and execution interface
freeze all available sampling and reasoning settings
authorize cost, data handling, and provider terms for the real runs
decide whether transparent tasks are sufficient or a held-out variant is required
prohibited_before_gate: state or imply a condition effect

limitations: No provider or model has been selected and no real model run is authorized.
The transparent tasks may be present in repository context and are unsuitable for a contamination-resistant leaderboard.
Four repetitions per condition can expose harness and gross response differences but cannot support broad statistical claims.
C5 and C6 are cumulative bundles, so the pilot estimates the effect of the whole declared bundle increment rather than one isolated file or tool.
